name: Kruskal.mergeAll_congr
lines: h : ∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1 i = uf1 j ↔ uf2 i = uf2 j
⊢ ∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1.mergeAll edges i = uf1.mergeAll edges j ↔ uf2.mergeAll edges i = uf2.mergeAll edges j
⊢ ∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1.mergeAll [] i = uf1.mergeAll [] j ↔ uf2.mergeAll [] i = uf2.mergeAll [] j
(∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1 i = uf1 j ↔ uf2 i = uf2 j) →
∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1.mergeAll edges i = uf1.mergeAll edges j ↔ uf2.mergeAll edges i = uf2.mergeAll edges j
uf1.mergeAll (e :: edges) i = uf1.mergeAll (e :: edges) j ↔
uf2.mergeAll (e :: edges) i = uf2.mergeAll (e :: edges) j
⊢ ∀ (i j : Fin n), uf1.merge e.u e.v i = uf1.merge e.u e.v j ↔ uf2.merge e.u e.v i = uf2.merge e.u e.v j
⊢ uf1.merge e.u e.v i = uf1.merge e.u e.v j ↔ uf2.merge e.u e.v i = uf2.merge e.u e.v j
⊢ ((if uf1 i = uf1 e.v then uf1 e.u else uf1 i) = if uf1 j = uf1 e.v then uf1 e.u else uf1 j) ↔
(if uf2 i = uf2 e.v then uf2 e.u else uf2 i) = if uf2 j = uf2 e.v then uf2 e.u else uf2 j

steps.tactic:
induction edges generalizing uf1 uf2 with
| nil => exact h
| cons e edges ih =>
  refine ih (uf1 := uf1.merge e.u e.v) (uf2 := uf2.merge e.u e.v) ?_
  intro i j; unfold UF.merge; grind
refine ih (uf1 := uf1.merge e.u e.v) (uf2 := uf2.merge e.u e.v) ?_
